Financial Calculators

Real Estate Calculator

Evaluate property investment deals including capitalization rates, cash flow projections, and ROI metrics.

Inputs

Calculations & Results

Annual Net Operating Income (NOI)
-
Capitalization Rate (%)
-
Monthly Cash Flow
-

Formula & Mathematical Equations

\text{Cap Rate} = \frac{\text{NOI}}{\text{Purchase Price}} \times 100

How It Works & Explanation

Cap rate defines unleveraged return rate. Net Operating Income (NOI) represents revenues minus operational upkeep expenses.
